CHAPTER 17 — कल्पनाकीर्तिः विजयते (KALPANAKIRTIH VIJAYATE)

Introduction — प्रस्तावना

The title of this chapter means 'The fame of Kalpana is victorious'. It tells, in simple original Sanskrit prose, the inspiring life-story of कल्पना चावला (Kalpana Chawla) — the first woman of Indian origin to travel to space. Born in the small town of Karnal in Haryana, she dreamt of flying as a child, pursued aeronautical engineering when very few girls entered that field, went on to earn a Master's degree and a doctorate in the United States, joined NASA, and flew twice aboard the Space Shuttle Columbia. Her second mission, STS-107, ended in tragedy on 1 February 2003, when Columbia broke apart during re-entry — yet her fame (कीर्तिः) lives on, inspiring millions of Indian girls to dream of science and space. In this lesson (NIOS Senior Secondary Sanskrit, Course 309) we read her story in Sanskrit prose with शब्दार्थ (word meanings) and English translation, reflect on her message, learn three authentic public-domain verses that echo her spirit, and study grammar (सन्धिः, समासः, विभक्तिः, कृदन्तः, स्त्रीलिङ्गरूपाणि) drawn from the passage.

1) जन्म बाल्यं च (Birth and Childhood)

हरियाणाप्रान्तस्य कर्णालनगरे कल्पना-चावला इत्यस्याः जन्म अभवत्। कल्पना बाल्ये एव आकाशं विमानानि च दृष्ट्वा अतीव प्रसन्ना भवति स्म। सा चिन्तयति स्म — अहम् अपि कदाचित् आकाशे उड्डयिष्यामि इति। सा स्वभावेन जिज्ञासुः, अध्ययनशीला, परिश्रमशीला च आसीत्। कर्णालनगरे एव सा प्रारम्भिकां शिक्षां प्राप्तवती।

शब्दार्थ: प्रान्तस्य = of the state/province; जन्म अभवत् = birth took place, was born; बाल्ये = in childhood; विमानानि = aeroplanes; दृष्ट्वा = having seen; प्रसन्ना = delighted (feminine); उड्डयिष्यामि = I shall fly; जिज्ञासुः = curious, eager to know; परिश्रमशीला = hard-working (feminine); प्रारम्भिकाम् = elementary, early; प्राप्तवती = obtained (feminine past form).

Translation: Kalpana Chawla was born in the town of Karnal in the state of Haryana. Even in childhood, seeing the sky and aeroplanes, she used to be delighted. She used to think — 'Some day I too shall fly in the sky.' By nature she was curious, studious and hard-working. She received her early education in Karnal itself.

2) शिक्षा साधना च (Education and Perseverance)

विद्यालयीयशिक्षानन्तरं कल्पना चण्डीगढनगरस्थे पञ्जाब-अभियान्त्रिकी-महाविद्यालये वैमानिक-अभियान्त्रिक्याः (aeronautical engineering) अध्ययनम् अकरोत्। तस्मिन् काले बालिकाः प्रायः तत् क्षेत्रं न अविशन्, परन्तु कल्पना धैर्येण स्वमार्गम् अचिनोत्। ततः सा अमेरिकादेशं गत्वा टेक्सास-विश्वविद्यालये स्नातकोत्तराम् उपाधिं (MS) प्राप्तवती, अनन्तरं च कोलोराडो-विश्वविद्यालयात् विद्यावारिधि-उपाधिं (PhD) प्राप्तवती। एवं निरन्तरपरिश्रमेण सा पदे पदे स्वप्नस्य समीपम् अगच्छत्।

शब्दार्थ: विद्यालयीयशिक्षानन्तरम् = after school education; नगरस्थे = situated in the city; महाविद्यालये = in the college; अध्ययनम् अकरोत् = did (her) study; प्रायः = generally, mostly; न अविशन् = did not enter; धैर्येण = with courage/steadfastness; अचिनोत् = chose; गत्वा = having gone; स्नातकोत्तराम् उपाधिम् = Master's degree; विद्यावारिधि-उपाधिम् = doctoral degree (PhD); निरन्तरपरिश्रमेण = by continuous hard work; पदे पदे = step by step.

Translation: After her school education, Kalpana studied aeronautical engineering at the Punjab Engineering College in Chandigarh. In those days girls generally did not enter that field, but Kalpana courageously chose her own path. Then, going to America, she obtained a Master's degree at the University of Texas, and afterwards a doctoral degree (PhD) from the University of Colorado. Thus, by continuous hard work, she moved step by step closer to her dream.

3) नासा-प्रवेशः प्रथमम् उड्डयनं च (Joining NASA and the First Flight)

१९८८ तमे ख्रिस्ताब्दे सा नासा-संस्थायाम् (NASA) अनुसन्धानकार्यम् आरब्धवती। १९९४ तमे ख्रिस्ताब्दे सा अन्तरिक्षयात्रि-पदाय चिता। १९९७ तमे ख्रिस्ताब्दे नवम्बरमासे सा कोलम्बिया इति अन्तरिक्षयानेन STS-87 इति अभियाने प्रथमवारम् अन्तरिक्षं गतवती। एवं सा भारतसम्भवा प्रथमा महिला अन्तरिक्षयात्री अभवत्। तदा सर्वे भारतीयाः महत् गौरवम् अनुभूतवन्तः।

शब्दार्थ: ख्रिस्ताब्दे = in the year (CE); संस्थायाम् = in the organisation; अनुसन्धानकार्यम् = research work; आरब्धवती = began (feminine); अन्तरिक्षयात्रि-पदाय = for the post of astronaut; चिता = was selected (feminine); अन्तरिक्षयानेन = by the spacecraft; अभियाने = in the mission; प्रथमवारम् = for the first time; भारतसम्भवा = born of India, of Indian origin; अनुभूतवन्तः = experienced, felt.

Translation: In the year 1988 she began research work at NASA. In 1994 she was selected for the post of astronaut. In November 1997 she went to space for the first time aboard the Space Shuttle Columbia on mission STS-87. Thus she became the first woman of Indian origin to be an astronaut in space. All Indians then felt great pride.

4) द्वितीयम् अभियानं महाप्रस्थानं च (The Second Mission and the Great Departure)

२००३ तमे ख्रिस्ताब्दे जनवरीमासस्य षोडशे दिनाङ्के सा पुनः तेनैव कोलम्बिया-यानेन STS-107 इति अभियाने अन्तरिक्षं गतवती। षोडश दिनानि यावत् सा षड्भिः सहयात्रिभिः सह बहून् विज्ञानप्रयोगान् अकरोत्। परन्तु फेब्रुवरीमासस्य प्रथमे दिनाङ्के पृथिवीं प्रति प्रत्यागमनसमये तत् यानं भग्नम् अभवत्। सप्त अपि यात्रिणः दिवङ्गताः। सर्वः लोकः शोकाकुलः अभवत्। तथापि तेषां साहसं त्यागश्च चिरं स्मरणीयौ स्तः।

शब्दार्थ: षोडशे दिनाङ्के = on the sixteenth date; तेनैव = by that very (same); षोडश दिनानि यावत् = for sixteen days; षड्भिः सहयात्रिभिः सह = together with six fellow travellers; विज्ञानप्रयोगान् = science experiments; प्रत्यागमनसमये = at the time of return; भग्नम् = broken; दिवङ्गताः = departed to heaven, passed away; शोकाकुलः = overwhelmed with grief; त्यागः = sacrifice; चिरं स्मरणीयौ = to be remembered for long.

Translation: On the sixteenth of January 2003 she again went to space aboard that same Columbia, on mission STS-107. For sixteen days she carried out many science experiments together with six fellow crew-members. But on the first of February, at the time of the return to Earth, the craft broke apart. All seven travellers passed away. The whole world was overwhelmed with grief. Yet their courage and sacrifice remain worthy of remembrance forever.

5) कीर्तिः प्रेरणा च (Fame and Inspiration)

शरीरं नश्यति, कीर्तिः तु न नश्यति। कल्पनायाः कीर्तिः अद्यापि विजयते। तस्याः नाम्ना नासा-संस्था एकं महासङ्गणकम् (supercomputer) अस्थापयत्; भारतस्य एकः मौसम-उपग्रहः अपि कल्पना-१ इति नाम्ना प्रसिद्धः अस्ति। तस्याः जीवनं भारतीयबालिकानां कृते महती प्रेरणा अस्ति — याः विज्ञानं गगनं च प्रति स्वप्नान् पश्यन्ति, ताः कल्पनायाः कथां श्रुत्वा नूतनम् उत्साहं लभन्ते।

शब्दार्थ: नश्यति = perishes; अद्यापि = even today; विजयते = is victorious, triumphs; नाम्ना = by the name; महासङ्गणकम् = supercomputer; अस्थापयत् = established, set up; मौसम-उपग्रहः = weather satellite; प्रसिद्धः = famous; बालिकानां कृते = for girls; महती प्रेरणा = great inspiration; श्रुत्वा = having heard; लभन्ते = obtain.

Translation: The body perishes, but fame does not perish. Kalpana's fame is victorious even today. NASA set up a supercomputer in her name; a weather satellite of India too is famous by the name 'Kalpana-1'. Her life is a great inspiration for Indian girls — those who dream of science and the sky gain new enthusiasm on hearing Kalpana's story.

6) कल्पनायाः सन्देशः (Kalpana's Message)

कल्पनायाः जीवनस्य सन्देशः अयम् — स्वप्नेभ्यः सफलतां प्रति मार्गः अस्ति एव। तं मार्गं द्रष्टुं दृष्टिः आवश्यकी, तस्मिन् मार्गे चलितुं साहसम् आवश्यकम्, गन्तव्यं प्राप्तुं च निरन्तरः परिश्रमः आवश्यकः। स्वप्नाः केवलं मनोरथाः न भवेयुः; उद्यमेन ते सत्याः भवन्ति। (This renders, as an idea, her famous conviction that a path does exist leading from dreams to success — one needs the vision to see it, the courage to walk it, and the perseverance to reach the goal.)

शब्दार्थ: सन्देशः = message; स्वप्नेभ्यः = from dreams; सफलताम् प्रति = towards success; मार्गः = path; द्रष्टुम् = to see; चलितुम् = to walk; गन्तव्यम् = destination; प्राप्तुम् = to reach/obtain; मनोरथाः = mere wishes, daydreams; उद्यमेन = by effort; सत्याः भवन्ति = become true.

7) प्रेरणाश्लोकाः (Inspirational Verses — authentic public-domain subhashitas)

(१) उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न मनोरथैः ।
    न हि सुप्तस्य सिंहस्य प्रविशन्ति मुखे मृगाः ॥
शब्दार्थ: उद्यमेन = by effort; सिध्यन्ति = are accomplished; कार्याणि = tasks; मनोरथैः = by mere wishes; सुप्तस्य सिंहस्य = of the sleeping lion; प्रविशन्ति = enter; मुखे = into the mouth; मृगाः = deer.
Translation: Tasks are accomplished by effort, not by mere wishes; deer do not walk into the mouth of a sleeping lion. Kalpana's degrees, her NASA selection and her space flights all came from tireless उद्यम, not from daydreaming.

(२) अमन्त्रमक्षरं नास्ति नास्ति मूलमनौषधम् ।
    अयोग्यः पुरुषो नास्ति योजकस्तत्र दुर्लभः ॥
शब्दार्थ: अमन्त्रम् = without sacred power; अक्षरम् = letter/syllable; मूलम् = root; अनौषधम् = without medicinal value; अयोग्यः = useless, unfit; योजकः = one who connects/organises rightly; दुर्लभः = rare.
Translation: There is no letter without mantra-power, no root without medicinal value, no person who is useless — rare is the one who knows how to put them to right use. Every child has potential; teachers, parents and society must be the योजक who help a girl like Kalpana find her path.

(३) उत्साहो बलवानार्य नास्त्युत्साहात्परं बलम् ।
    सोत्साहस्य हि लोकेषु न किञ्चिदपि दुर्लभम् ॥
शब्दार्थ: उत्साहः = enthusiasm, zeal; बलवान् = strong, mighty; आर्य = O noble one; उत्साहात् परम् = greater than enthusiasm; बलम् = strength; सोत्साहस्य = for one who has enthusiasm; न किञ्चिदपि दुर्लभम् = nothing at all is unattainable.
Translation: Enthusiasm is strength, O noble one; there is no strength greater than enthusiasm. For the enthusiastic, nothing in the worlds is unattainable. From a small town in Haryana to the stars — Kalpana's journey proves this verse true.

8) व्याकरणम् (Grammar from the Lesson)

(A) सन्धिः (Sandhi — joining of sounds), with सन्धि-विच्छेद (splitting):
  • दीर्घ-सन्धिः (like vowels merge into one long vowel): विद्या + आलयः = विद्यालयः; शोक + आकुलः = शोकाकुलः; न + अस्ति = नास्ति; अद्य + अपि = अद्यापि।
  • यण्-सन्धिः (इ/ई before an unlike vowel becomes य्): इति + अस्याः = इत्यस्याः; प्रति + आगमनम् = प्रत्यागमनम्; नास्ति + उत्साहात् = नास्त्युत्साहात्।
  • गुण-सन्धिः (अ/आ + उ = ओ): महा + उत्साहः = महोत्साहः।

(B) समासः (Compounds): अन्तरिक्षयात्री = अन्तरिक्षे यात्री (सप्तमी-तत्पुरुषः); विज्ञानप्रयोगः = विज्ञानस्य प्रयोगः (षष्ठी-तत्पुरुषः); महाविद्यालयः = महान् विद्यालयः (कर्मधारयः); भारतसम्भवा = भारतात् सम्भवा (पञ्चमी-तत्पुरुषः)।

(C) विभक्तिः (Case endings) from the passage: कर्णालनगरे = सप्तमी (in Karnal town); धैर्येण = तृतीया (by courage); कोलोराडो-विश्वविद्यालयात् = पञ्चमी (from the University of Colorado); बालिकानाम् = षष्ठी बहुवचनम् (of girls); स्वप्नेभ्यः = पञ्चमी बहुवचनम् (from dreams); अभियाने = सप्तमी (in the mission)।

(D) कृदन्ताः (Participles and infinitives): क्त्वा-प्रत्ययः (having done —): दृष्ट्वा (having seen), गत्वा (having gone), श्रुत्वा (having heard)। तुमुन्-प्रत्ययः (in order to —): द्रष्टुम् (to see), चलितुम् (to walk), प्राप्तुम् (to obtain)। क्त-प्रत्ययः (past passive): भग्नम् (broken), चिता (selected, fem.)। क्तवतु-प्रत्ययः (past active): प्राप्तवती, गतवती, आरब्धवती — note the feminine ending -वती (masculine would be प्राप्तवान्, गतवान्)।

(E) स्त्रीलिङ्गरूपाणि (Feminine forms): Because the lesson narrates a woman's life, feminine forms abound: प्रथमा महिला (first woman), प्रसन्ना, जिज्ञासुः, परिश्रमशीला, महती प्रेरणा (महत् → महती), and the क्तवतु forms in -वती (गतवती, प्राप्तवती)। Learning to convert गतवान् → गतवती is a key skill of this chapter.

सारांशः (Summary)

In this chapter you read the life of Kalpana Chawla in simple Sanskrit: her birth in Karnal (Haryana), her childhood dream of flying, her courageous choice of aeronautical engineering at Punjab Engineering College, her MS from the University of Texas and PhD from the University of Colorado, her research at NASA from 1988, her selection as an astronaut in 1994, her historic first flight aboard Columbia (STS-87, November 1997) as the first woman of Indian origin in space, her second mission STS-107 (launched 16 January 2003) and the heartbreaking loss of Columbia and all seven crew on 1 February 2003 during re-entry. You learnt that though the body perishes, कीर्तिः (fame earned by noble deeds) is victorious — NASA's 'Kalpana' supercomputer and India's 'Kalpana-1' satellite keep her name alive, and her story inspires Indian girls toward science and space. You studied three verses on effort, potential and enthusiasm, and drew grammar from the passage: दीर्घ/यण्/गुण sandhi, tatpurusha and karmadharaya compounds, vibhakti, कृदन्त forms (क्त्वा, तुमुन्, क्त, क्तवतु) and feminine forms in -वती.

Explain her educational journey (Punjab Engineering College; MS, University of Texas; PhD, University of Colorado) and the qualities — curiosity, courage and perseverance — that carried her through a field few girls then entered.

sections.heading: Birth, childhood and the dream of flight
bullets: Kalpana Chawla was born in Karnal, a small town in Haryana — हरियाणाप्रान्तस्य कर्णालनगरे तस्याः जन्म अभवत्.
As a child she loved watching the sky and aeroplanes and dreamt: अहम् अपि कदाचित् आकाशे उड्डयिष्यामि (I too shall fly in the sky some day).
The lesson describes her nature with feminine adjectives: जिज्ञासुः (curious), अध्ययनशीला (studious), परिश्रमशीला (hard-working).
She received her early education in Karnal itself before moving out for higher studies.

sections.heading: Education as perseverance
bullets: She studied aeronautical engineering at Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh, at a time when very few girls entered that field — she chose her path धैर्येण (with courage).
She then earned a Master's degree (स्नातकोत्तरा उपाधिः) at the University of Texas in the USA.
She completed her doctorate — विद्यावारिधि-उपाधिः (PhD) — at the University of Colorado.
The prose sums up her method: निरन्तरपरिश्रमेण पदे पदे स्वप्नस्य समीपम् अगच्छत् — by continuous effort she moved step by step toward her dream.

sections.heading: NASA and the two Columbia missions
bullets: In 1988 she began research work at NASA (अनुसन्धानकार्यम् आरब्धवती) and in 1994 she was selected as an astronaut (अन्तरिक्षयात्रि-पदाय चिता).
In November 1997 she flew aboard Space Shuttle Columbia on mission STS-87 — becoming the first woman of Indian origin (भारतसम्भवा प्रथमा महिला) in space.
On 16 January 2003 she flew again on Columbia, mission STS-107 — a 16-day science mission with six fellow crew-members and many विज्ञानप्रयोगाः.
On 1 February 2003, during re-entry (प्रत्यागमनसमये), Columbia broke apart; all seven crew perished (सप्त अपि यात्रिणः दिवङ्गताः) — their courage and sacrifice remain forever worthy of remembrance.

sections.heading: Message, fame and legacy
bullets: Her life's message, rendered in the lesson: स्वप्नेभ्यः सफलतां प्रति मार्गः अस्ति एव — a path from dreams to success does exist; it needs vision to see, courage to walk, and perseverance to reach the goal.
शरीरं नश्यति, कीर्तिः तु न नश्यति — the body perishes but fame earned by noble deeds does not; hence the title कल्पनाकीर्तिः विजयते.
NASA named a supercomputer 'Kalpana' after her, and India's weather satellite was named 'Kalpana-1' in her honour.
Her story gives Indian girls who dream of science and space new enthusiasm — तस्याः जीवनं भारतीयबालिकानां कृते महती प्रेरणा अस्ति.

sections.heading: Verses and grammar from the lesson
bullets: उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न मनोरथैः — tasks are accomplished by effort, not wishes; deer do not enter a sleeping lion's mouth.
अमन्त्रमक्षरं नास्ति... योजकस्तत्र दुर्लभः — nothing and no one is useless; rare is the योजक who puts potential to right use.
उत्साहो बलवानार्य — there is no strength greater than enthusiasm; for the enthusiastic nothing is unattainable.
Sandhi: विद्या+आलयः=विद्यालयः (दीर्घ), इति+अस्याः=इत्यस्याः (यण्), महा+उत्साहः=महोत्साहः (गुण); समासः: अन्तरिक्षयात्री (सप्तमी-तत्पुरुषः), महाविद्यालयः (कर्मधारयः).
कृदन्ताः: दृष्ट्वा/गत्वा (क्त्वा), द्रष्टुम्/चलितुम् (तुमुन्), भग्नम् (क्त), गतवती/प्राप्तवती (क्तवतु, feminine -वती).

key_takeaways: Kalpana Chawla, born in Karnal (Haryana), rose from a small town to become the first woman of Indian origin in space.
Her path — Punjab Engineering College, MS (University of Texas), PhD (University of Colorado), NASA — models perseverance: निरन्तरपरिश्रमेण पदे पदे.
She flew twice on Columbia: STS-87 (November 1997) and STS-107 (launched 16 January 2003, lost on re-entry 1 February 2003 with all seven crew).
शरीरं नश्यति, कीर्तिः तु न नश्यति — noble deeds make fame immortal; hence कल्पनाकीर्तिः विजयते.
Her message: a path from dreams to success does exist — it demands vision, courage and continuous effort (उद्यमेन, न मनोरथैः).
Her honours — NASA's 'Kalpana' supercomputer and India's 'Kalpana-1' satellite — and her story inspire Indian girls toward science and space.
The lesson teaches दीर्घ/यण्/गुण sandhi, tatpurusha and karmadharaya compounds, vibhakti, कृदन्त forms (क्त्वा, तुमुन्, क्त, क्तवतु) and feminine -वती forms.

glossary.definition: Fame, glory earned by noble deeds; in the lesson, that which does not perish even when the body does.
Is victorious, triumphs; from जि (to conquer) — the chapter title says Kalpana's fame triumphs even today.
Astronaut — literally 'a traveller in space' (अन्तरिक्षे यात्री, a सप्तमी-tatpurusha compound).
Flying, flight; the childhood dream of Kalpana — आकाशे उड्डयनम्.
Mission, expedition; used for the space missions STS-87 and STS-107.
Research, investigation; Kalpana began अनुसन्धानकार्यम् at NASA in 1988.
Doctorate (PhD) — literally 'ocean of learning'; the degree she earned from the University of Colorado.
Return, coming back (प्रति + आगमनम्, yan-sandhi); the re-entry phase during which Columbia was lost.
Departed to heaven, passed away — the respectful word used for the seven crew members of STS-107.
Overwhelmed with grief (शोक + आकुलः, dirgha-sandhi); how the whole world felt on 1 February 2003.
Effort, industry; the verse उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि teaches that effort, not wishing, accomplishes tasks.
A mere wish or daydream; contrasted with उद्यम — dreams must be backed by effort to come true.
One who connects or organises rightly; the rare person who puts everyone's hidden potential to proper use.
Enthusiasm, zeal; the verse declares no strength greater than enthusiasm — nothing is unattainable for the enthusiastic.
Past-active participle suffix; feminine forms end in -वती (गतवती, प्राप्तवती), masculine in -वान् (गतवान्).

worksheet.title: Worksheet — कल्पनाकीर्तिः विजयते (NIOS Sanskrit 309, Chapter 17)
worksheet.instructions: Attempt all questions. Write Sanskrit words in Devanagari and give explanations in English. Refer to the prose passage and the verses of the lesson where needed.

questions.question: कल्पना चावला प्रथमवारम् केन अभियानेन अन्तरिक्षं गतवती? (By which mission did Kalpana Chawla first go to space?)
questions.explanation: Her first flight was STS-87 aboard Columbia in November 1997.

questions.question: 'उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न मनोरथैः' — अस्य श्लोकस्य केन्द्रीयभावः कः? (What is the central idea of this verse?)
options: Tasks are accomplished by effort, not by mere wishes
questions.answer: Tasks are accomplished by effort, not by mere wishes
questions.explanation: उद्यमेन = by effort; न मनोरथैः = not by daydreams — even a lion must hunt.

questions.question: कल्पनायाः जन्म ______ प्रान्तस्य कर्णालनगरे अभवत्। (Kalpana was born in Karnal town of the state of ______.)
questions.explanation: Karnal is a town in the state of Haryana (हरियाणाप्रान्तः).

questions.question: Translate into English: 'एवं सा भारतसम्भवा प्रथमा महिला अन्तरिक्षयात्री अभवत्।'
questions.answer: Thus she became the first woman astronaut of Indian origin (the first woman of Indian origin to travel to space). भारतसम्भवा = born of India / of Indian origin; प्रथमा महिला = first woman; अन्तरिक्षयात्री = astronaut, space traveller.
questions.explanation: The sentence marks the historic significance of her STS-87 flight of November 1997.

questions.question: सन्धि-विच्छेदं कुरुत — (a) इत्यस्याः (b) शोकाकुलः। नाम अपि लिखत। (Split the sandhi and name its type.)
questions.answer: (a) इत्यस्याः = इति + अस्याः — यण्-सन्धिः (the इ of इति becomes य् before the unlike vowel अ). (b) शोकाकुलः = शोक + आकुलः — दीर्घ-सन्धिः (अ + आ = आ).
questions.explanation: Yan-sandhi turns इ/ई into य् before an unlike vowel; dirgha-sandhi merges like vowels into one long vowel.

questions.question: अधोलिखितपदानां विभक्तिं प्रत्ययं वा लिखत — धैर्येण, कर्णालनगरे, गत्वा। (State the case or the krit suffix of each word.)
questions.answer: धैर्येण = तृतीया विभक्तिः (instrumental — 'with courage'). कर्णालनगरे = सप्तमी विभक्तिः (locative — 'in Karnal town'). गत्वा = क्त्वा-प्रत्ययान्तम् अव्ययम् (gerund — 'having gone').
questions.explanation: तृतीया shows means, सप्तमी shows place; क्त्वा makes the 'having done' form of a root.

questions.question: कल्पनायाः जीवनस्य सन्देशं स्वशब्दैः लिखत। (Explain Kalpana's life-message in your own words, quoting the lesson's Sanskrit rendering.)
questions.answer: The lesson renders her conviction as: स्वप्नेभ्यः सफलतां प्रति मार्गः अस्ति एव — a path from dreams to success does exist. To travel it one needs the vision (दृष्टिः) to see the path, the courage (साहसम्) to walk on it, and continuous hard work (निरन्तरः परिश्रमः) to reach the destination. Dreams must not remain mere मनोरथाः; through उद्यम they become real — as her own journey from Karnal to space proved.
questions.explanation: Her message joins स्वप्न (dream) with उद्यम (effort) — both are necessary; neither alone suffices.

questions.question: 'कल्पनाकीर्तिः विजयते' — इति शीर्षकं साधु इति सिद्धं कुरुत। Discuss how Kalpana Chawla's fame remains victorious even after her death, citing her honours and her influence on Indian girls.
questions.answer: The title means 'Kalpana's fame is victorious'. The lesson teaches: शरीरं नश्यति, कीर्तिः तु न नश्यति — the body perishes, but fame earned by noble deeds does not. Kalpana died on 1 February 2003 when Columbia broke apart during re-entry, yet her fame triumphs: (1) NASA established a supercomputer named 'Kalpana' in her honour; (2) India named its weather satellite 'Kalpana-1' after her; (3) schools, scholarships and awards across India carry her name; (4) most importantly, her story — a girl from Karnal who became the first Indian-origin woman in space through sheer perseverance — gives Indian girls who dream of science and space new confidence and enthusiasm (नूतनम् उत्साहम्). Because her deeds keep inspiring new generations, her कीर्ति is not a memory of the past but a living force — hence the title is apt: कल्पनाकीर्तिः विजयते.
questions.explanation: A strong answer quotes शरीरं नश्यति, कीर्तिः तु न नश्यति, names the honours, and explains the living inspiration for girls.

questions.question: कल्पना-चावला-विषये पञ्च सरलानि संस्कृतवाक्यानि लिखत। (Write five simple Sanskrit sentences about Kalpana Chawla, with English meanings.)
questions.answer:
1. कल्पनायाः जन्म कर्णालनगरे अभवत्। (Kalpana was born in Karnal town.)
2. सा बाल्ये आकाशे उड्डयनस्य स्वप्नम् अपश्यत्। (In childhood she saw the dream of flying in the sky.)
3. सा परिश्रमेण विद्यावारिधि-उपाधिं प्राप्तवती। (Through hard work she obtained the PhD degree.)
4. सा कोलम्बिया-यानेन द्विवारम् अन्तरिक्षं गतवती। (She went to space twice by the craft Columbia.)
5. तस्याः कीर्तिः अद्यापि विजयते। (Her fame is victorious even today.)
questions.explanation: Simple sentences using chapter vocabulary and feminine क्तवतु forms (प्राप्तवती, गतवती).

questions.question: Read the verse and answer: 'अमन्त्रमक्षरं नास्ति नास्ति मूलमनौषधम् । अयोग्यः पुरुषो नास्ति योजकस्तत्र दुर्लभः ॥' — (a) What three things does the verse say do not exist? (b) Who is the योजक? (c) How does this verse apply to Kalpana Chawla's life?
questions.answer: (a) There is no letter without mantra-power (अमन्त्रम् अक्षरं नास्ति), no root without medicinal value (मूलम् अनौषधं नास्ति), and no person who is useless (अयोग्यः पुरुषो नास्ति). (b) The योजक is the rare person who knows how to connect things and people to their right use — a wise organiser, teacher or guide. (c) Kalpana was a girl from a small town in an era when few girls studied engineering; her potential could have gone unnoticed. Her own determination, and the teachers and institutions that recognised and directed her talent (school, Punjab Engineering College, NASA), acted as योजक — proving that every child has potential and society must help connect it to opportunity.
questions.explanation: The verse teaches universal potential; the rare skill is right utilisation — exactly the lesson of Kalpana's rise.

questions.question: कल्पना-चावलायाः जन्म कुत्र अभवत्? (Where was Kalpana Chawla born?)
questions.explanation: She was born in Karnal (कर्णालनगरम्), Haryana.

questions.question: कर्णालनगरं कस्मिन् प्रान्ते अस्ति? (In which state is Karnal?)
questions.explanation: Karnal is in Haryana — हरियाणाप्रान्तस्य कर्णालनगरे.

questions.question: कल्पनायाः प्रथमम् अन्तरिक्ष-अभियानं किम् आसीत्? (Which was Kalpana's first space mission?)
questions.explanation: STS-87 aboard Columbia, November 1997, was her first flight.

questions.question: कस्मिन् वर्षे सा प्रथमवारम् अन्तरिक्षं गतवती? (In which year did she first go to space?)
questions.explanation: Her first flight, STS-87, launched in November 1997.

questions.question: कल्पना केन अन्तरिक्षयानेन अन्तरिक्षं गतवती? (By which space shuttle did Kalpana travel to space?)
questions.explanation: Both her missions, STS-87 and STS-107, flew aboard Space Shuttle Columbia.

questions.question: STS-107 अभियानं कदा प्रारब्धम्? (When was mission STS-107 launched?)
questions.explanation: STS-107 launched on 16 January 2003 — जनवरीमासस्य षोडशे दिनाङ्के.

questions.question: कोलम्बिया-यानस्य दुर्घटना कदा अभवत्? (When did the Columbia disaster occur?)
questions.explanation: Columbia broke apart during re-entry on 1 February 2003 — फेब्रुवरीमासस्य प्रथमे दिनाङ्के.

questions.question: STS-107 अभियाने कति यात्रिणः आसन्? (How many crew members were on mission STS-107?)
questions.explanation: All seven crew members perished — सप्त अपि यात्रिणः दिवङ्गताः.

questions.question: कस्मिन् वर्षे कल्पना नासा-संस्थायाम् अनुसन्धानकार्यम् आरब्धवती? (In which year did Kalpana begin research work at NASA?)
questions.explanation: She began research at NASA in 1988; she was selected as an astronaut in 1994.

questions.question: कस्मिन् वर्षे सा अन्तरिक्षयात्रि-पदाय चिता? (In which year was she selected for the post of astronaut?)
questions.explanation: NASA selected her as an astronaut candidate in 1994.

questions.question: कल्पना विद्यावारिधि-उपाधिं (PhD) कस्मात् विश्वविद्यालयात् प्राप्तवती? (From which university did Kalpana obtain her PhD?)
questions.explanation: MS from the University of Texas; PhD from the University of Colorado.

questions.question: सा स्नातकोत्तराम् उपाधिं (MS) कुत्र प्राप्तवती? (Where did she obtain her Master's degree?)
questions.explanation: After PEC she earned her MS at the University of Texas in the USA.

questions.question: कल्पना कस्मिन् महाविद्यालये अभियान्त्रिक्याः अध्ययनम् अकरोत्? (In which college did Kalpana study engineering?)
questions.explanation: She studied aeronautical engineering at Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh.

questions.question: STS-107 अभियानं कति दिनानि यावत् आसीत्? (For how many days did mission STS-107 last in space?)
questions.explanation: STS-107 was a 16-day science mission — षोडश दिनानि यावत्.

questions.question: कल्पना कस्याः अभियान्त्रिक्याः अध्ययनम् अकरोत्? (Which branch of engineering did Kalpana study?)
questions.explanation: Her childhood love of flight led her to aeronautical engineering.

questions.question: कल्पनायाः उपाधीनां साधुः क्रमः कः? (What is the correct order of Kalpana's degrees?)
questions.explanation: Engineering at PEC Chandigarh, then MS at Texas, then PhD at Colorado.

questions.question: 'तस्मिन् काले बालिकाः प्रायः तत् क्षेत्रं न अविशन्' — अनेन किं सूच्यते? (What does this sentence indicate?)
options: In those days girls rarely entered aeronautical engineering
Girls were not allowed to study at all
The college had no seats for anyone
questions.answer: In those days girls rarely entered aeronautical engineering
questions.explanation: It highlights how courageous and unusual her choice was for a girl of that era.

questions.question: बाल्ये कल्पना किं दृष्ट्वा प्रसन्ना भवति स्म? (Seeing what did Kalpana feel delighted in childhood?)
options: आकाशं विमानानि च (the sky and aeroplanes)
questions.answer: आकाशं विमानानि च (the sky and aeroplanes)
questions.explanation: आकाशं विमानानि च दृष्ट्वा अतीव प्रसन्ना भवति स्म — the seed of her dream of flight.

questions.question: 'जिज्ञासुः' इति पदस्य कः अर्थः? (What is the meaning of जिज्ञासुः?)
questions.explanation: जिज्ञासुः = one who desires to know (from ज्ञा, to know).

questions.question: 'परिश्रमशीला' इति विशेषणं कल्पनायाः कं गुणं बोधयति? (What quality of Kalpana does परिश्रमशीला convey?)
questions.explanation: परिश्रम (hard work) + शीला (having as one's nature) — feminine form.

questions.question: 'निरन्तरपरिश्रमेण सा पदे पदे स्वप्नस्य समीपम् अगच्छत्' — अस्य वाक्यस्य भावः कः? (What is the sense of this sentence?)
options: By continuous effort she moved step by step closer to her dream
She walked to college every day on foot
She gave up her dream midway
questions.answer: By continuous effort she moved step by step closer to her dream
questions.explanation: पदे पदे = step by step; her degrees and NASA career were gradual fruits of sustained effort.

questions.question: कल्पनायाः शिक्षायात्रायाः कः गुणः प्रधानतया प्रकटितः? (Which quality is chiefly revealed by Kalpana's educational journey?)
questions.explanation: She chose an unusual field with courage and pursued degree after degree with sustained effort.

questions.question: 'विद्यावारिधिः' इति उपाधिः कां उपाधिं सूचयति? (Which degree does the term विद्यावारिधिः denote?)
questions.explanation: विद्यावारिधिः — 'ocean of learning' — is the Sanskrit rendering of the doctorate.

questions.question: 'उड्डयनम्' इति पदस्य कः अर्थः? (What is the meaning of उड्डयनम्?)
questions.explanation: उड्डयनम् = flight; from the root डी (to fly) with उत् prefix.

questions.question: 'अन्तरिक्षयात्री' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः? (What does अन्तरिक्षयात्री mean?)
questions.explanation: अन्तरिक्षे यात्री = a traveller in space — an astronaut.

questions.question: 'दिवङ्गताः' इति पदस्य कः भावार्थः? (What is the sense of the word दिवङ्गताः?)
questions.explanation: दिवम् गताः = gone to heaven — a respectful word for the departed crew.

questions.question: 'शोकाकुलः' इति पदस्य कः अर्थः? (What is the meaning of शोकाकुलः?)
questions.explanation: शोक (grief) + आकुल (agitated/filled) — the world's state after the tragedy.

questions.question: 'कीर्तिः' इति पदस्य कः अर्थः? (What is the meaning of कीर्तिः?)
questions.explanation: कीर्तिः = fame earned by noble deeds; it does not perish with the body.

questions.question: 'विजयते' इति क्रियापदस्य कः अर्थः? (What does the verb विजयते mean?)
questions.explanation: वि + जि (to conquer), आत्मनेपद — 'triumphs, is victorious'.

questions.question: 'प्रत्यागमनम्' इति पदस्य कः अर्थः? (What is the meaning of प्रत्यागमनम्?)
questions.explanation: प्रति + आगमनम् = coming back; Columbia was lost during its return to Earth.

questions.question: 'सा अन्तरिक्षं गतवती' — अत्र 'गतवती' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः? (In this sentence, what does गतवती mean?)
questions.explanation: गतवती is the feminine क्तवतु past-active form of गम् — 'she went'.

questions.question: 'बालिकानां कृते' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः? (What does बालिकानां कृते mean?)
questions.explanation: षष्ठी + कृते = 'for, for the sake of' — her life is an inspiration for girls.

questions.question: 'अनुसन्धानम्' इति पदस्य कः अर्थः? (What is the meaning of अनुसन्धानम्?)
questions.explanation: She began अनुसन्धानकार्यम् (research work) at NASA in 1988.

questions.question: 'षड्भिः सहयात्रिभिः सह' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः? (What does षड्भिः सहयात्रिभिः सह mean?)
questions.explanation: षड्भिः = with six (तृतीया); with Kalpana herself the crew numbered seven.

questions.question: 'तत् यानं भग्नम् अभवत्' — अस्य वाक्यस्य साधुः अनुवादः कः? (Which is the correct translation of this sentence?)
questions.explanation: भग्नम् (क्त form of भञ्ज्, to break) = broken; the shuttle disintegrated on re-entry.

questions.question: 'उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न ______' — रिक्तस्थाने किं पदम्? (Which word completes the verse?)
questions.explanation: Tasks are accomplished by effort, not by mere wishes (मनोरथैः).

questions.question: सुप्तसिंहस्य दृष्टान्तेन श्लोकः किं शिक्षयति? (What does the example of the sleeping lion teach?)
options: Even the mighty must act — deer do not enter a sleeping lion's mouth
Lions should sleep more to save energy
Hunting is easy for the strong
questions.answer: Even the mighty must act — deer do not enter a sleeping lion's mouth
questions.explanation: Without effort even the strongest gains nothing; food does not come to the sleeping.

questions.question: 'अयोग्यः पुरुषो नास्ति योजकस्तत्र दुर्लभः' — अत्र किं दुर्लभम् इति उक्तम्? (According to this line, who/what is rare?)
questions.explanation: No person is useless; rare is the योजक who puts each to right use.

questions.question: 'अमन्त्रमक्षरं नास्ति' इत्यस्य कः भावः? (What is the sense of अमन्त्रमक्षरं नास्ति?)
options: There is no letter without sacred/mantra power
Letters have no value at all
One should not learn the alphabet
questions.answer: There is no letter without sacred/mantra power
questions.explanation: Every syllable has potential power — a metaphor for the hidden worth in everything.

questions.question: 'उत्साहो बलवानार्य नास्त्युत्साहात्परं बलम्' — अनेन किं परमं बलम्? (According to this verse, what is the greatest strength?)
questions.explanation: There is no strength greater than enthusiasm — नास्ति उत्साहात् परं बलम्.

questions.question: 'सोत्साहस्य हि लोकेषु न किञ्चिदपि दुर्लभम्' — अस्य कः अर्थः? (What does this line mean?)
options: For the enthusiastic person nothing in the worlds is unattainable
Rare things are found only in other worlds
questions.answer: For the enthusiastic person nothing in the worlds is unattainable
questions.explanation: सोत्साहस्य = for one possessed of उत्साह; न किञ्चिदपि दुर्लभम् = nothing at all is hard to obtain.

questions.question: कल्पनायाः निरन्तरपरिश्रमस्य कृते कः श्लोकः सर्वाधिकम् उपयुज्यते? (Which verse best matches Kalpana's continuous hard work?)
options: उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न मनोरथैः
questions.answer: उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न मनोरथैः
questions.explanation: Her degrees, NASA selection and space flights were fruits of उद्यम, not of mere wishing.

questions.question: 'नास्ति मूलमनौषधम्' इत्यस्य कः भावः? (What is the sense of नास्ति मूलमनौषधम्?)
options: There is no root without medicinal value
One should not use herbal medicine
questions.answer: There is no root without medicinal value
questions.explanation: Every root has some healing property — again, nothing in the world is useless.

questions.question: 'न हि सुप्तस्य सिंहस्य प्रविशन्ति मुखे मृगाः' — अत्र 'मृगाः' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः? (What does मृगाः mean here?)
questions.explanation: मृगाः = deer; they do not walk into the sleeping lion's mouth by themselves.

questions.question: कल्पनायाः जीवनस्य मुख्यः सन्देशः कः? (What is the main message of Kalpana's life?)
options: A path from dreams to success exists — walk it with courage and effort
Dreams are useless in real life
questions.answer: A path from dreams to success exists — walk it with courage and effort
questions.explanation: स्वप्नेभ्यः सफलतां प्रति मार्गः अस्ति एव — vision, courage and perseverance make dreams real.

questions.question: 'स्वप्नाः केवलं मनोरथाः न भवेयुः' — अनेन किं बोध्यते? (What is conveyed by this sentence?)
options: Dreams should not remain mere wishes — effort must make them true
Wishes always come true by themselves
Sleep is more important than dreams
questions.answer: Dreams should not remain mere wishes — effort must make them true
questions.explanation: उद्यमेन ते सत्याः भवन्ति — through effort dreams become real.

questions.question: नासा-संस्था कल्पनायाः नाम्ना किम् अस्थापयत्? (What did NASA establish in Kalpana's name?)
questions.explanation: NASA named a supercomputer 'Kalpana' in her honour.

questions.question: 'कल्पना-१' इति नाम कस्य वस्तुनः? (What is named 'Kalpana-1'?)
questions.explanation: India's weather satellite (MetSat) was renamed Kalpana-1 in her honour.

questions.question: 'कल्पनाकीर्तिः विजयते' इति शीर्षकस्य कः अर्थः? (What is the meaning of the chapter title?)
options: The fame of Kalpana is victorious
questions.answer: The fame of Kalpana is victorious
questions.explanation: कल्पनायाः कीर्तिः विजयते — her glory triumphs even after her passing.

questions.question: 'शरीरं नश्यति, कीर्तिः तु न नश्यति' — अस्य कः भावः? (What is the sense of this sentence?)
options: The body perishes but fame earned by noble deeds does not
Both body and fame perish together
Neither body nor fame ever perishes
questions.answer: The body perishes but fame earned by noble deeds does not
questions.explanation: This is why the lesson says Kalpana's कीर्ति still विजयते.

questions.question: कल्पनायाः कथा भारतीयबालिकानां कृते कथं प्रेरणा भवति? (How does Kalpana's story become an inspiration for Indian girls?)
options: It shows that a girl from a small town can reach space through effort
It shows that only boys can become astronauts
It shows that space travel is impossible
It shows that wealth alone brings success
questions.answer: It shows that a girl from a small town can reach space through effort
questions.explanation: From Karnal to Columbia — her journey proves dreams plus effort know no boundaries of gender or place.

questions.question: दुर्घटनायाः अनन्तरम् अपि कल्पनायाः कीर्तिः किमर्थं जीवति? (Why does Kalpana's fame live on even after the tragedy?)
options: Because her deeds and courage keep inspiring new generations
Because she returned safely to Earth
Because the mission was kept secret
Because fame never depends on deeds
questions.answer: Because her deeds and courage keep inspiring new generations
questions.explanation: Fame born of noble deeds is self-renewing: each inspired student keeps her कीर्ति alive.

questions.question: 'विद्या + आलयः = विद्यालयः' — अत्र कः सन्धिः? (Which sandhi is this?)
questions.explanation: आ + आ merge into one long आ — dirgha (long-vowel) sandhi.

questions.question: 'नास्ति' इत्यस्य सन्धि-विच्छेदः कः? (What is the sandhi-split of नास्ति?)
questions.explanation: अ + अ = आ (दीर्घ-सन्धिः): न + अस्ति = नास्ति.

questions.question: 'इति + अस्याः' इत्यनयोः सन्धौ किं रूपं भवति? (What is the sandhi form of इति + अस्याः?)
questions.explanation: यण्-सन्धिः: the इ of इति becomes य् before the unlike vowel अ.

questions.question: 'प्रत्यागमनम्' इत्यस्य सन्धि-विच्छेदः कः? (What is the sandhi-split of प्रत्यागमनम्?)
questions.explanation: यण्-सन्धिः: इ + आ → या; प्रति + आगमनम् = प्रत्यागमनम्.

questions.question: 'महा + उत्साहः = महोत्साहः' — अत्र कः सन्धिः? (Which sandhi is this?)
questions.explanation: आ + उ = ओ — guna sandhi, as in महा + उत्साहः = महोत्साहः.

questions.question: 'अद्यापि' इत्यस्य सन्धि-विच्छेदः कः? (What is the sandhi-split of अद्यापि?)
questions.explanation: दीर्घ-सन्धिः: अ + अ = आ; अद्य + अपि = अद्यापि (even today).

questions.question: 'अन्तरिक्षयात्री' इति पदे कः समासः? (Which compound is in अन्तरिक्षयात्री?)
questions.explanation: विग्रहः — अन्तरिक्षे यात्री (a traveller IN space): locative tatpurusha.

questions.question: 'महाविद्यालयः' इति पदे कः समासः? (Which compound is in महाविद्यालयः?)
questions.explanation: विग्रहः — महान् विद्यालयः (a great school/college): karmadharaya.

questions.question: 'विज्ञानप्रयोगः' इत्यस्य साधुः विग्रहः कः? (What is the correct vigraha of विज्ञानप्रयोगः?)
questions.explanation: षष्ठी-तत्पुरुषः — 'an experiment OF science'.

questions.question: 'कर्णालनगरे' इति पदे का विभक्तिः? (Which case is in कर्णालनगरे?)
questions.explanation: सप्तमी (locative) — 'in Karnal town'.

questions.question: 'धैर्येण' इति पदे का विभक्तिः? (Which case is in धैर्येण?)
questions.explanation: तृतीया (instrumental) — 'with/by courage'.

questions.question: 'स्वप्नेभ्यः सफलतां प्रति मार्गः' — अत्र 'स्वप्नेभ्यः' इति पदे का विभक्तिः? (Which case is in स्वप्नेभ्यः?)
questions.explanation: पञ्चमी plural — 'FROM dreams (to success)'. (The चतुर्थी plural has the same form, but the sense here is ablative.)

questions.question: 'गत्वा' इति पदे कः प्रत्ययः? (Which suffix is in गत्वा?)
questions.explanation: गम् + क्त्वा = गत्वा, 'having gone'.

questions.question: 'द्रष्टुम्' इति पदे कः प्रत्ययः? (Which suffix is in द्रष्टुम्?)
questions.explanation: दृश् + तुमुन् = द्रष्टुम्, 'to see' (infinitive of purpose).

questions.question: 'गतवती' इति पदे कः प्रत्ययः? (Which suffix is in गतवती?)
questions.explanation: गम् + क्तवतु = गतवान्; feminine गतवती — 'she went'.

questions.question: 'प्राप्तवान्' इत्यस्य स्त्रीलिङ्गरूपं किम्? (What is the feminine form of प्राप्तवान्?)
questions.explanation: क्तवतु forms make the feminine in -वती: प्राप्तवान् → प्राप्तवती.

questions.question: 'बालिकानाम्' इति पदे का विभक्तिः किं वचनं च? (State the case and number of बालिकानाम्.)
questions.explanation: षष्ठी plural — 'of girls' (भारतीयबालिकानां कृते = for Indian girls).

questions.question: 'भग्नम्' इति पदे कः प्रत्ययः? (Which suffix is in भग्नम्?)
questions.explanation: भञ्ज् + क्त = भग्न (broken) — past passive participle; here neuter भग्नम् agreeing with यानम्.

questions.question: 'सा प्रथमवारम् अन्तरिक्षं गतवती।' — साधुः आङ्ग्लानुवादः कः? (Which is the correct English translation?)
options: She went to space for the first time.
She will go to space for the first time.
She goes to space every year.
questions.answer: She went to space for the first time.
questions.explanation: गतवती = went (past, feminine); प्रथमवारम् = for the first time.

questions.question: 'She obtained the degree' — इत्यस्य साधुः संस्कृतानुवादः कः? (Which is the correct Sanskrit translation?)
questions.explanation: Feminine subject सा takes प्राप्तवती; उपाधिम् is द्वितीया (object).

questions.question: 'अहम् अपि कदाचित् आकाशे उड्डयिष्यामि' — अत्र 'उड्डयिष्यामि' इति क्रियापदं कस्मिन् लकारे अस्ति? (In which tense/mood is उड्डयिष्यामि?)
questions.explanation: उड्डयिष्यामि = 'I shall fly' — first-person future (लृट् लकारः).

questions.question: 'तस्याः कीर्तिः अद्यापि विजयते।' — साधुः आङ्ग्लानुवादः कः? (Which is the correct English translation?)
options: Her fame is victorious even today.
His fame will be victorious tomorrow.
questions.answer: Her fame is victorious even today.
questions.explanation: तस्याः = her; अद्यापि = even today; विजयते = is victorious.

questions.question: 'Kalpana was born in Karnal town' — इत्यस्य साधुः संस्कृतानुवादः कः? (Which is the correct Sanskrit rendering?)
questions.explanation: कर्णालनगरे (सप्तमी, place) + कल्पनायाः (षष्ठी) + जन्म अभवत् — the lesson's own construction.

questions.question: कल्पना-चावलायाः जन्म हरियाणाप्रान्तस्य कर्णालनगरे अभवत्। (Kalpana Chawla was born in Karnal, Haryana.)
questions.explanation: हरियाणाप्रान्तस्य कर्णालनगरे तस्याः जन्म अभवत्।

questions.question: कल्पनायाः प्रथमम् अभियानम् STS-107 आसीत्। (Kalpana's first mission was STS-107.)
questions.explanation: Her first mission was STS-87 (November 1997); STS-107 was her second.

questions.question: STS-107 अभियानं २००३ तमवर्षस्य जनवरीमासस्य षोडशे दिनाङ्के प्रारब्धम्। (Mission STS-107 was launched on 16 January 2003.)
questions.explanation: It launched on 16 January 2003 and was lost on re-entry on 1 February 2003.

questions.question: कल्पना विद्यावारिधि-उपाधिं टेक्सास-विश्वविद्यालयात् प्राप्तवती। (Kalpana obtained her PhD from the University of Texas.)
questions.explanation: Her MS was from the University of Texas; her PhD was from the University of Colorado.

questions.question: कल्पना भारतसम्भवा प्रथमा महिला अन्तरिक्षयात्री आसीत्। (Kalpana was the first woman of Indian origin to go to space.)
questions.explanation: With STS-87 in 1997 she became the first Indian-origin woman in space.

questions.question: 'विजयते' इत्यस्य अर्थः 'पराजितः भवति' इति। (The word विजयते means 'is defeated'.)
questions.explanation: विजयते means 'is victorious, triumphs' — the opposite of being defeated.

questions.question: 'उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति' इति श्लोकः वदति यत् कार्याणि मनोरथैः एव सिध्यन्ति। (The verse says tasks are accomplished by mere wishes.)
questions.explanation: The verse says the opposite: by effort (उद्यमेन), NOT by wishes (न मनोरथैः).

questions.question: कल्पनायाः सन्देशः अस्ति — परिश्रमं विना अपि स्वप्नाः सत्याः भवन्ति। (Kalpana's message is that dreams come true even without effort.)
questions.explanation: Her message joins dreams WITH effort: स्वप्नाः उद्यमेन सत्याः भवन्ति.

questions.question: 'नास्ति' इत्यस्य सन्धि-विच्छेदः 'न + अस्ति' इति अस्ति। (The sandhi-split of नास्ति is न + अस्ति.)
questions.explanation: दीर्घ-सन्धिः: अ + अ = आ.

questions.question: 'गतवती' इति क्तवतु-प्रत्ययान्तं स्त्रीलिङ्गरूपम् अस्ति। (गतवती is a feminine past-active participle formed with क्तवतु.)
questions.explanation: गम् + क्तवतु = गतवान् (m.) / गतवती (f.) — 'went'.

questions.question: कल्पनायाः जन्म हरियाणाप्रान्तस्य ______-नगरे अभवत्। (Kalpana was born in the town of ______ in Haryana.)
questions.explanation: She was born in Karnal (कर्णालनगरम्).

questions.question: कल्पनायाः अन्तरिक्षयानस्य नाम ______ इति आसीत्। (The name of Kalpana's space shuttle was ______.)
questions.explanation: Both her missions flew on Space Shuttle Columbia (कोलम्बिया).

questions.question: STS-107 अभियाने ______ यात्रिणः आसन्। (There were ______ crew members on mission STS-107.)
questions.explanation: Seven (सप्त) crew members, all of whom perished on 1 February 2003.

questions.question: सा भारतसम्भवा ______ महिला अन्तरिक्षयात्री अभवत्। (She became the ______ woman astronaut of Indian origin.)
questions.explanation: प्रथमा = first (feminine); she was the first Indian-origin woman in space.

questions.question: तस्याः ______ अद्यापि विजयते। (Her ______ is victorious even today.)
questions.explanation: कीर्तिः (fame) — echoing the chapter title कल्पनाकीर्तिः विजयते.

questions.question: उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति ______ न मनोरथैः। (Complete the verse.)
questions.explanation: कार्याणि (tasks) are accomplished by effort, not by wishes.

questions.question: न हि सुप्तस्य ______ प्रविशन्ति मुखे मृगाः। (Complete the verse.)
questions.explanation: Deer do not enter the mouth of the sleeping lion (सुप्तस्य सिंहस्य).

questions.question: अयोग्यः पुरुषो नास्ति ______ तत्र दुर्लभः। (Complete the verse with the missing noun, प्रथमा-form.)
questions.explanation: योजकस्तत्र दुर्लभः — rare is the one who puts things to right use.

questions.question: उत्साहो ______ आर्य नास्त्युत्साहात्परं बलम्। (Complete the verse.)
questions.explanation: उत्साहो बलवानार्य — enthusiasm is strength; none greater than it.

questions.question: स्वप्नेभ्यः सफलतां प्रति ______ अस्ति एव। (From dreams toward success a ______ does exist.)
questions.explanation: मार्गः = path — the lesson's rendering of Kalpana's famous conviction.

questions.question: न + अस्ति = ______ (सन्धिं कुरुत। Join the sandhi.)
questions.explanation: दीर्घ-सन्धिः: अ + अ = आ.

questions.question: इति + अस्याः = ______ (सन्धिं कुरुत। Join the sandhi.)
questions.explanation: यण्-सन्धिः: इ → य् before the unlike vowel अ.

questions.question: विद्या + ______ = विद्यालयः (सन्धि-विच्छेदं पूरयत। Complete the split.)
questions.explanation: विद्या + आलयः = विद्यालयः (दीर्घ-सन्धिः) — 'abode of learning'.

questions.question: 'गम्' धातोः क्त्वा-प्रत्ययान्तं रूपं ______ अस्ति। (The क्त्वा form of the root गम् is ______.)
questions.explanation: गम् + क्त्वा = गत्वा, 'having gone' — as in अमेरिकादेशं गत्वा.

questions.question: 'गतवान्' इत्यस्य स्त्रीलिङ्गरूपं ______ अस्ति। (The feminine form of गतवान् is ______.)
questions.explanation: क्तवतु forms take -वती in the feminine: गतवान् → गतवती.

questions.question: कल्पना-चावलायाः जन्मस्थानं किम्? सा कुत्र प्रारम्भिकां शिक्षां प्राप्तवती? (What was Kalpana Chawla's birthplace, and where did she receive her early education?)
questions.answer: Her birthplace was Karnal (कर्णालनगरम्) in the state of Haryana (हरियाणाप्रान्तः). She received her early education in Karnal itself — कर्णालनगरे एव सा प्रारम्भिकां शिक्षां प्राप्तवती।
questions.explanation: Both her birth and her school education belong to Karnal, Haryana.

questions.question: कल्पनायाः द्वे अन्तरिक्ष-अभियाने सयानं सदिनाङ्कं च लिखत। (Name Kalpana's two space missions with the shuttle and the dates.)
questions.answer: First mission: STS-87 aboard Space Shuttle Columbia (कोलम्बिया), launched in November 1997 — her first journey to space and the flight that made her the first woman of Indian origin in space. Second mission: STS-107, also aboard Columbia, launched on 16 January 2003; after a 16-day science mission, the shuttle was lost during re-entry on 1 February 2003.
questions.explanation: Both flights were on Columbia: STS-87 (Nov 1997) and STS-107 (16 Jan – 1 Feb 2003).

questions.question: कल्पनायाः शिक्षायात्रां क्रमेण वर्णयत — महाविद्यालयतः विद्यावारिधिपर्यन्तम्। (Describe Kalpana's educational journey in order, from college to doctorate.)
questions.answer: After school in Karnal, she studied aeronautical engineering (वैमानिक-अभियान्त्रिकी) at Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh. Then she went to America (अमेरिकादेशं गत्वा) and earned a Master's degree (स्नातकोत्तरा उपाधिः) at the University of Texas. Finally she obtained her doctorate — विद्यावारिधि-उपाधिः (PhD) — from the University of Colorado. Each step took her closer to her dream of flight: निरन्तरपरिश्रमेण पदे पदे स्वप्नस्य समीपम् अगच्छत्।
questions.explanation: PEC (BE, aeronautical) → University of Texas (MS) → University of Colorado (PhD).

questions.question: वैमानिक-अभियान्त्रिक्याः चयनं कल्पनायाः कृते साहसपूर्णं किमर्थम् आसीत्? (Why was choosing aeronautical engineering a courageous decision for Kalpana?)
questions.answer: In those days girls generally did not enter that field — तस्मिन् काले बालिकाः प्रायः तत् क्षेत्रं न अविशन्। Choosing aeronautical engineering meant going against social expectations, studying in a class with hardly any other girls, and preparing for a career many thought unsuitable for women. Kalpana chose her own path with courage (धैर्येण स्वमार्गम् अचिनोत्) because her childhood dream of flight mattered more to her than convention. This courage later carried her to America, to NASA and finally to space.
questions.explanation: The courage lay in defying gender expectations of the era for the sake of her dream.

questions.question: पाठे कल्पनायाः स्वभावः कैः विशेषणैः वर्णितः? तेषाम् अर्थं लिखत। (With which adjectives does the lesson describe Kalpana's nature? Give their meanings.)
questions.answer: The lesson says: सा स्वभावेन जिज्ञासुः, अध्ययनशीला, परिश्रमशीला च आसीत् — she was by nature curious (जिज्ञासुः, eager to know), studious (अध्ययनशीला, devoted to study) and hard-working (परिश्रमशीला, industrious). Note that all three are feminine forms, since they describe a woman.
questions.explanation: Three feminine adjectives: जिज्ञासुः, अध्ययनशीला, परिश्रमशीला.

questions.question: आङ्ग्लभाषायाम् अनुवदत — 'षोडश दिनानि यावत् सा षड्भिः सहयात्रिभिः सह बहून् विज्ञानप्रयोगान् अकरोत्।'
questions.answer: For sixteen days she carried out many science experiments together with six fellow travellers (crew-members). षोडश दिनानि यावत् = for sixteen days; षड्भिः सहयात्रिभिः सह = with six co-travellers; विज्ञानप्रयोगान् अकरोत् = performed science experiments.
questions.explanation: STS-107 was a 16-day microgravity research mission with a crew of seven in all.

questions.question: शब्दार्थं लिखत — उड्डयनम्, यानम्, अनुसन्धानम्, दिवङ्गताः, अद्यापि। (Give the English meanings.)
questions.answer: उड्डयनम् = flying, flight; यानम् = vehicle, craft (here, the space shuttle); अनुसन्धानम् = research, investigation; दिवङ्गताः = passed away, departed to heaven; अद्यापि = even today.
questions.explanation: Core vocabulary of the lesson's prose narrative.

questions.question: 'शरीरं नश्यति, कीर्तिः तु न नश्यति।' — अनुवादं कृत्वा कल्पनायाः जीवनेन सह योजयत। (Translate and connect with Kalpana's life.)
questions.answer: Translation: The body perishes, but fame does not perish. Connection: Kalpana died in the Columbia tragedy of 1 February 2003, yet her fame lives on — in NASA's 'Kalpana' supercomputer, India's 'Kalpana-1' satellite, and above all in the millions of Indian girls her story inspires. Her noble deeds made her कीर्ति immortal, which is why the chapter is titled कल्पनाकीर्तिः विजयते.
questions.explanation: The maxim explains how the chapter title holds true despite her death.

questions.question: 'उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न मनोरथैः...' — श्लोकस्य अनुवादं नीतिं च लिखत। (Translate the verse and state its moral.)
questions.answer: Translation: Tasks are accomplished by effort, not by mere wishes; deer do not enter the mouth of a sleeping lion. Moral: Success demands action — even the mighty lion must hunt for its food. Daydreaming (मनोरथ) achieves nothing; steady effort (उद्यम) achieves everything, as Kalpana's own journey from Karnal to space shows.
questions.explanation: The sleeping-lion image drives home that nothing is gained without effort.

questions.question: 'अमन्त्रमक्षरं नास्ति...' इति श्लोकस्य केन्द्रीयभावं लिखत। (State the central idea of the verse अमन्त्रमक्षरं नास्ति.)
questions.answer: The verse says: there is no letter without mantra-power, no root without medicinal value, and no person who is useless — only the योजक (the one who knows how to put each to its right use) is rare. Central idea: everything and everyone has hidden potential; what the world lacks is not talent but wise guides who recognise and channel it.
questions.explanation: Universal potential + the rarity of the right 'connector' (योजक).

questions.question: 'उत्साहो बलवानार्य...' इति श्लोकः कल्पनायाः जीवने कथं प्रतिफलितः? (How is the verse on उत्साह reflected in Kalpana's life?)
questions.answer: The verse declares enthusiasm the greatest strength — नास्ति उत्साहात् परं बलम् — and says nothing is unattainable for the enthusiastic (सोत्साहस्य न किञ्चिदपि दुर्लभम्). Kalpana had no special wealth or connections; her strength was her unquenchable enthusiasm for flight. It carried her through engineering college as one of very few girls, through higher studies in a foreign land, and through NASA's demanding astronaut selection — until the girl from Karnal reached the stars. Her life is living proof of the verse.
questions.explanation: उत्साह was the engine of every stage of her journey.

questions.question: शब्दार्थं लिखत — उद्यमः, मनोरथः, योजकः, उत्साहः। (Give the meanings of these words from the verses.)
questions.answer: उद्यमः = effort, industry; मनोरथः = a mere wish, daydream; योजकः = one who connects/organises things to their right use; उत्साहः = enthusiasm, zeal.
questions.explanation: Key nouns of the three inspirational verses.

questions.question: कल्पनायाः सन्देशे स्वप्नस्य परिश्रमस्य च कः सम्बन्धः? (In Kalpana's message, what is the relation between dreams and effort?)
questions.answer: Her message — स्वप्नेभ्यः सफलतां प्रति मार्गः अस्ति एव — holds that dreams and effort are partners, not alternatives. The dream gives direction: without it there is nothing to strive for. But the dream alone is a मनोरथ (mere wish); only vision (दृष्टिः) to see the path, courage (साहसम्) to walk it, and continuous hard work (निरन्तरः परिश्रमः) turn it into reality — उद्यमेन ते सत्याः भवन्ति. Kalpana dreamt of flying as a child and then worked for decades to make that dream true.
questions.explanation: Dream = direction; effort = the vehicle. Both are necessary.

questions.question: कल्पनायाः स्मृतौ के सम्मानाः प्रदत्ताः? (What honours were given in Kalpana's memory?)
questions.answer: NASA established a supercomputer named 'Kalpana' (महासङ्गणकम्) in her honour, and India's weather satellite was named 'Kalpana-1' (कल्पना-१ इति मौसम-उपग्रहः) after her. Besides these, schools, scholarships, awards and institutions across India bear her name, keeping her memory alive.
questions.explanation: The two honours named in the lesson: NASA's Kalpana supercomputer and India's Kalpana-1 satellite.

questions.question: कल्पना अद्य नास्ति, तथापि पाठः 'कल्पनाकीर्तिः विजयते' इति वदति — किमर्थम्? स्वमतं सयुक्तिकं लिखत। (Kalpana is no more, yet the lesson says her fame is victorious — why? Give a reasoned answer.)
questions.answer: Because fame earned by noble deeds outlives the body: शरीरं नश्यति, कीर्तिः तु न नश्यति। Kalpana's achievements — first Indian-origin woman in space, a life of perseverance from Karnal to NASA — continue to act in the world. Institutions bear her name, a satellite and a supercomputer honour her, and countless Indian girls take up science because her story tells them the sky is not the limit. Fame that still changes lives is not a relic; it is a living, victorious force. Hence विजयते (present tense — 'is victorious'), not विजितवती (was victorious).
questions.explanation: The present-tense विजयते is deliberate: her inspiration is an ongoing victory.

questions.question: सन्धि-विच्छेदं सन्धिनाम च लिखत — विद्यालयः, अद्यापि, नास्ति, इत्यस्याः। (Split each sandhi and name its type.)
questions.answer: विद्यालयः = विद्या + आलयः (दीर्घ-सन्धिः); अद्यापि = अद्य + अपि (दीर्घ-सन्धिः); नास्ति = न + अस्ति (दीर्घ-सन्धिः); इत्यस्याः = इति + अस्याः (यण्-सन्धिः).
questions.explanation: Three dirgha splits (like vowels → long vowel) and one yan split (इ → य्).

questions.question: सन्धिं कृत्वा लिखत — (a) प्रति + आगमनम् (b) महा + उत्साहः (c) शोक + आकुलः। (Join the sandhis.)
questions.answer: (a) प्रति + आगमनम् = प्रत्यागमनम् (यण्-सन्धिः: इ + आ → या). (b) महा + उत्साहः = महोत्साहः (गुण-सन्धिः: आ + उ = ओ). (c) शोक + आकुलः = शोकाकुलः (दीर्घ-सन्धिः: अ + आ = आ).
questions.explanation: One example each of yan, guna and dirgha sandhi from the lesson.

questions.question: समास-विग्रहं समासनाम च लिखत — अन्तरिक्षयात्री, विज्ञानप्रयोगः, महाविद्यालयः। (Give the vigraha and name the compound type.)
questions.answer: अन्तरिक्षयात्री = अन्तरिक्षे यात्री (a traveller in space) — सप्तमी-तत्पुरुषः। विज्ञानप्रयोगः = विज्ञानस्य प्रयोगः (an experiment of science) — षष्ठी-तत्पुरुषः। महाविद्यालयः = महान् विद्यालयः (a great school, i.e. college) — कर्मधारयः।
questions.explanation: Two tatpurusha compounds (locative and genitive) and one karmadharaya.

questions.question: विभक्तिं वचनं च लिखत — कर्णालनगरे, धैर्येण, बालिकानाम्, स्वप्नेभ्यः। (State the case and number of each word.)
questions.answer: कर्णालनगरे = सप्तमी एकवचनम् (in Karnal town); धैर्येण = तृतीया एकवचनम् (with courage); बालिकानाम् = षष्ठी बहुवचनम् (of girls); स्वप्नेभ्यः = पञ्चमी बहुवचनम् (from dreams).
questions.explanation: Locative, instrumental, genitive plural and ablative plural respectively.

questions.question: प्रत्ययं लिखत — दृष्ट्वा, द्रष्टुम्, भग्नम्, आरब्धवती। (Name the krit suffix in each form.)
questions.answer: दृष्ट्वा = क्त्वा-प्रत्ययः (having seen); द्रष्टुम् = तुमुन्-प्रत्ययः (in order to see); भग्नम् = क्त-प्रत्ययः (broken — past passive participle); आरब्धवती = क्तवतु-प्रत्ययः, स्त्रीलिङ्गे -वती (she began).
questions.explanation: The four krit suffixes taught in the chapter: क्त्वा, तुमुन्, क्त, क्तवतु.

questions.question: संस्कृतेन अनुवदत — (a) She went to America. (b) Her fame is victorious even today.
questions.answer: (a) सा अमेरिकादेशं गतवती (or अगच्छत्)। (b) तस्याः कीर्तिः अद्यापि विजयते।
questions.explanation: Feminine past form गतवती; अद्यापि = even today; विजयते = is victorious.

questions.question: कल्पनायाः शिक्षाविषये त्रीणि सरलानि संस्कृतवाक्यानि रचयत। (Compose three simple Sanskrit sentences about Kalpana's education.)
questions.answer: Model answer: 1. कल्पना कर्णालनगरे प्रारम्भिकां शिक्षां प्राप्तवती। (Kalpana received her early education in Karnal.) 2. सा महाविद्यालये वैमानिक-अभियान्त्रिक्याः अध्ययनम् अकरोत्। (She studied aeronautical engineering in college.) 3. सा अमेरिकादेशे विद्यावारिधि-उपाधिं प्राप्तवती। (She obtained the PhD degree in America.) Any grammatically correct simple sentences on her education deserve full marks.
questions.explanation: Sentences should use correct feminine forms (प्राप्तवती) and proper vibhakti.

questions.question: कल्पना-चावलायाः जीवनवृत्तं क्रमेण लिखत — जन्मतः अन्तिम-अभियानपर्यन्तम्। (Write a life-sketch of Kalpana Chawla in order, from her birth to her final mission.)
questions.answer: Kalpana Chawla was born in Karnal, Haryana (हरियाणाप्रान्तस्य कर्णालनगरे). As a child she loved watching the sky and aeroplanes and dreamt of flying one day. After early schooling in Karnal, she studied aeronautical engineering at Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh — a rare choice for a girl of that era. She then went to America, took a Master's degree at the University of Texas and a PhD at the University of Colorado. In 1988 she began research work at NASA, and in 1994 she was selected as an astronaut. In November 1997 she flew aboard Space Shuttle Columbia on mission STS-87, becoming the first woman of Indian origin in space (भारतसम्भवा प्रथमा महिला अन्तरिक्षयात्री). On 16 January 2003 she flew again on Columbia (STS-107), a 16-day science mission with six crew-mates. On 1 February 2003, during re-entry, Columbia broke apart and all seven crew perished. Her fame, however, is victorious even today — कल्पनाकीर्तिः विजयते।
questions.explanation: Full marks need the correct order: Karnal → PEC → Texas MS → Colorado PhD → NASA 1988 → astronaut 1994 → STS-87 (1997) → STS-107 (2003) → 1 Feb 2003.

questions.question: 'कल्पनायाः शिक्षायात्रा साधनायाः उदाहरणम् अस्ति' — इति कथनं विश्लेषयत। के प्रतिबन्धाः आसन्? कैः गुणैः सा तान् अजयत्? (Analyse how her educational journey exemplifies perseverance. What obstacles stood in her way, and by which qualities did she overcome them?)
questions.answer: Obstacles: (1) She came from a small town, far from centres of aerospace science. (2) In her era girls rarely entered engineering, let alone aeronautical engineering — तस्मिन् काले बालिकाः प्रायः तत् क्षेत्रं न अविशन्; social expectations were against her. (3) Higher study required leaving home for a foreign country. (4) The path from student to NASA astronaut is long and fiercely competitive. Qualities: curiosity (जिज्ञासा) that fixed her aim early; courage (धैर्यम्) to choose an unusual field — धैर्येण स्वमार्गम् अचिनोत्; sustained hard work (निरन्तरपरिश्रमः) through BE, MS and PhD; and enthusiasm (उत्साहः) that never dimmed across decades. The lesson sums it up: निरन्तरपरिश्रमेण सा पदे पदे स्वप्नस्य समीपम् अगच्छत् — step by step, not by luck or by leaps, she walked from Karnal to the stars. That steady, unbroken walking is exactly what साधना (persevering practice) means.
questions.explanation: Answer should pair each obstacle with the quality that overcame it, citing the lesson's Sanskrit.

questions.question: अधोलिखितं गद्यांशम् आङ्ग्लभाषायाम् अनुवदत — '२००३ तमे ख्रिस्ताब्दे जनवरीमासस्य षोडशे दिनाङ्के सा पुनः तेनैव कोलम्बिया-यानेन STS-107 इति अभियाने अन्तरिक्षं गतवती। परन्तु फेब्रुवरीमासस्य प्रथमे दिनाङ्के पृथिवीं प्रति प्रत्यागमनसमये तत् यानं भग्नम् अभवत्। सप्त अपि यात्रिणः दिवङ्गताः। तथापि तेषां साहसं त्यागश्च चिरं स्मरणीयौ स्तः।'
questions.answer: Translation: On the sixteenth of January in the year 2003, she again went to space aboard that same craft Columbia, on the mission STS-107. But on the first of February, at the time of the return to Earth, that craft broke apart. All seven travellers passed away. Even so, their courage and sacrifice remain worthy of remembrance forever. (Key words: तेनैव यानेन = by that very craft; प्रत्यागमनसमये = at the time of return/re-entry; भग्नम् अभवत् = broke apart; दिवङ्गताः = passed away; चिरं स्मरणीयौ = to be long remembered.)
questions.explanation: Tests connected-prose translation of the tragedy paragraph, handled factually and respectfully.

questions.question: पाठे आगताः त्रयः श्लोकाः कल्पनायाः जीवनस्य कान् कान् पक्षान् प्रकाशयन्ति? प्रत्येकं श्लोकं सार्थं सोदाहरणं व्याख्यात। (Which aspects of Kalpana's life do the three verses of the lesson illuminate? Explain each verse with meaning and example.)
questions.answer: (1) उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न मनोरथैः — tasks are achieved by effort, not wishes; deer do not enter a sleeping lion's mouth. This illuminates her work-ethic: degrees, NASA research and astronaut selection came from decades of उद्यम, not from dreaming alone. (2) अमन्त्रमक्षरं नास्ति... योजकस्तत्र दुर्लभः — nothing and no one is without worth; rare is the योजक who puts potential to use. This illuminates her origins: a girl from small-town Karnal carried immense hidden potential, which her own resolve and good teachers/institutions connected to opportunity. (3) उत्साहो बलवानार्य नास्त्युत्साहात्परं बलम् — enthusiasm is the greatest strength; for the enthusiastic nothing is unattainable. This illuminates her spirit: neither social convention, nor distance, nor competition could stop a person whose enthusiasm for flight never dimmed. Together the verses map her life: potential (verse 2) + effort (verse 1) + enthusiasm (verse 3) = the journey from Karnal to the stars.
questions.explanation: Each verse should be tied to a distinct aspect: potential, effort, enthusiasm.

questions.question: 'कल्पनायाः जीवनं भारतीयबालिकानां कृते महती प्रेरणा अस्ति' — इति कथनं सोदाहरणं समीक्षत। (Critically discuss, with examples, the statement that Kalpana's life is a great inspiration for Indian girls.)
questions.answer: The statement is well founded. (1) Role-model effect: before Kalpana, an Indian girl dreaming of space had no example to point to; after STS-87 (1997) she could say — a woman born in Karnal has already done it. (2) Breaking stereotypes: Kalpana entered aeronautical engineering when girls rarely did, showing that fields are not male or female — only preparation matters. (3) The power of ordinary beginnings: she came not from wealth or a metropolis but from a small town, proving that talent plus effort outweigh circumstances. (4) Living institutions: the Kalpana-1 satellite, NASA's Kalpana supercomputer, and the many schools and scholarships in her name keep placing her story before new students. (5) Even her death teaches: the tragedy of 1 February 2003 shows science demands courage and sacrifice, and that a meaningful life is measured by what one dares, not merely by its length. Today, when Indian women serve as scientists and mission directors in ISRO's programmes, the path Kalpana lit is being walked by thousands — her life is indeed महती प्रेरणा.
questions.explanation: A balanced answer cites role-model effect, stereotype-breaking, honours, and the lesson of courage.

questions.question: कल्पनायाः जीवनसन्देशं व्याख्यात। एकः छात्रः तं सन्देशं स्वजीवने कथं आचरेत्? (Explain Kalpana's life-message. How should a student practise it in daily life?)
questions.answer: Her message, as the lesson renders it: स्वप्नेभ्यः सफलतां प्रति मार्गः अस्ति एव — a path from dreams to success does exist; one needs vision (दृष्टिः) to see it, courage (साहसम्) to walk it, and continuous effort (निरन्तरः परिश्रमः) to reach the goal. Dreams must not remain mere मनोरथाः; उद्यमेन ते सत्याः भवन्ति. A student can practise this by: (1) choosing a clear, honest dream (an aim of study or service) rather than drifting; (2) making a step-by-step plan — पदे पदे, as Kalpana went degree by degree; (3) working daily, without waiting for perfect conditions; (4) not abandoning the path when others discourage — as she did not when few girls chose her field; (5) keeping enthusiasm alive by remembering why the dream matters. Dream boldly, work steadily, fear nothing — that is the message.
questions.explanation: Explanation of the message plus concrete daily-life applications.

questions.question: पाठे आगतानां सन्धीनां त्रयः प्रकाराः सोदाहरणं व्याख्येयाः — दीर्घः, यण्, गुणश्च। (Explain, with examples from the lesson, the three types of sandhi found in it: dirgha, yan and guna.)
questions.answer: (1) दीर्घ-सन्धिः: when two like simple vowels (अ/आ, इ/ई, उ/ऊ) meet, they merge into the corresponding long vowel. Examples: विद्या + आलयः = विद्यालयः (आ+आ=आ); न + अस्ति = नास्ति (अ+अ=आ); शोक + आकुलः = शोकाकुलः (अ+आ=आ); अद्य + अपि = अद्यापि। (2) यण्-सन्धिः: when इ/ई (or उ/ऊ, ऋ) is followed by an UNLIKE vowel, it changes to the semivowel य् (व्, र्). Examples: इति + अस्याः = इत्यस्याः (इ→य्); प्रति + आगमनम् = प्रत्यागमनम्; नास्ति + उत्साहात् = नास्त्युत्साहात्। (3) गुण-सन्धिः: when अ/आ is followed by इ/ई the result is ए, and by उ/ऊ the result is ओ. Example from the lesson: महा + उत्साहः = महोत्साहः (आ+उ=ओ). To split (सन्धि-विच्छेद), reverse the rule: find the long vowel, य्, or ए/ओ at the joint and restore the original vowels.
questions.explanation: Definitions, at least one lesson example per type, and the reverse (splitting) method.

questions.question: 'कल्पना चावला' इति विषये षड्वाक्यात्मकम् एकं संस्कृतानुच्छेदं रचयत, आङ्ग्लानुवादसहितम्। (Compose a Sanskrit paragraph of six sentences on Kalpana Chawla, with English translation.)
questions.answer: Model answer: कल्पना चावला हरियाणाप्रान्तस्य कर्णालनगरे जन्म प्राप्तवती। (Kalpana Chawla was born in Karnal, Haryana.) बाल्ये एव सा आकाशे उड्डयनस्य स्वप्नम् अपश्यत्। (Even in childhood she dreamt of flying in the sky.) सा परिश्रमेण अभियान्त्रिक्याः उच्चशिक्षां प्राप्तवती। (Through hard work she attained higher education in engineering.) ततः सा नासा-संस्थायाम् अन्तरिक्षयात्री अभवत्। (Then she became an astronaut at NASA.) सा कोलम्बिया-यानेन द्विवारम् अन्तरिक्षं गतवती। (She travelled to space twice aboard Columbia.) अद्यापि तस्याः कीर्तिः विजयते, तस्याः जीवनं च सर्वासां बालिकानां कृते प्रेरणा अस्ति। (Even today her fame is victorious, and her life is an inspiration for all girls.) Any grammatically sound paragraph covering birth, dream, education, NASA, missions and legacy merits full marks.
questions.explanation: Composition must use correct feminine verb-forms and chapter vocabulary.

questions.question: गद्यांशं पठित्वा उत्तरत — 'हरियाणाप्रान्तस्य कर्णालनगरे कल्पना-चावला इत्यस्याः जन्म अभवत्। कल्पना बाल्ये एव आकाशं विमानानि च दृष्ट्वा अतीव प्रसन्ना भवति स्म। सा चिन्तयति स्म — अहम् अपि कदाचित् आकाशे उड्डयिष्यामि इति।' (a) कल्पनायाः जन्म कुत्र अभवत्? (b) बाल्ये सा किं दृष्ट्वा प्रसन्ना भवति स्म? (c) सा किं चिन्तयति स्म?
questions.answer: (a) कल्पनायाः जन्म हरियाणाप्रान्तस्य कर्णालनगरे अभवत् — she was born in Karnal town of Haryana state. (b) सा आकाशं विमानानि च दृष्ट्वा प्रसन्ना भवति स्म — seeing the sky and aeroplanes she used to feel delighted. (c) सा चिन्तयति स्म — 'अहम् अपि कदाचित् आकाशे उड्डयिष्यामि' इति — she used to think, 'Some day I too shall fly in the sky.'
questions.explanation: Direct comprehension of the birth-and-childhood paragraph.

questions.question: गद्यांशं पठित्वा उत्तरत — '१९८८ तमे ख्रिस्ताब्दे सा नासा-संस्थायाम् अनुसन्धानकार्यम् आरब्धवती। १९९४ तमे ख्रिस्ताब्दे सा अन्तरिक्षयात्रि-पदाय चिता। १९९७ तमे ख्रिस्ताब्दे नवम्बरमासे सा कोलम्बिया इति अन्तरिक्षयानेन STS-87 इति अभियाने प्रथमवारम् अन्तरिक्षं गतवती।' (a) सा कदा नासायाम् अनुसन्धानम् आरब्धवती? (b) सा कदा अन्तरिक्षयात्रि-पदाय चिता? (c) प्रथमम् अभियानं किं, कदा च?
questions.answer: (a) १९८८ तमे ख्रिस्ताब्दे (in 1988) she began research work at NASA. (b) १९९४ तमे ख्रिस्ताब्दे (in 1994) she was selected for the post of astronaut. (c) Her first mission was STS-87, aboard the shuttle Columbia, in November 1997 (१९९७ तमे वर्षे नवम्बरमासे).
questions.explanation: Timeline recall: 1988 research → 1994 selection → November 1997 first flight.

questions.question: गद्यांशं पठित्वा उत्तरत — '२००३ तमे ख्रिस्ताब्दे जनवरीमासस्य षोडशे दिनाङ्के सा पुनः तेनैव कोलम्बिया-यानेन STS-107 इति अभियाने अन्तरिक्षं गतवती। षोडश दिनानि यावत् सा षड्भिः सहयात्रिभिः सह बहून् विज्ञानप्रयोगान् अकरोत्।' (a) STS-107 कदा प्रारब्धम्? (b) अभियानं कति दिनानि आसीत्? (c) 'षड्भिः सहयात्रिभिः सह' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः?
questions.answer: (a) STS-107 was launched on 16 January 2003 — जनवरीमासस्य षोडशे दिनाङ्के. (b) The mission lasted sixteen days — षोडश दिनानि. (c) 'षड्भिः सहयात्रिभिः सह' means 'together with six fellow travellers (crew-members)'; with Kalpana included, the crew numbered seven.
questions.explanation: Comprehension of the STS-107 paragraph, including the instrumental plural phrase.

questions.question: गद्यांशं पठित्वा उत्तरत — 'शरीरं नश्यति, कीर्तिः तु न नश्यति। कल्पनायाः कीर्तिः अद्यापि विजयते। तस्याः जीवनं भारतीयबालिकानां कृते महती प्रेरणा अस्ति।' (a) किं नश्यति, किं च न नश्यति? (b) 'अद्यापि' इति पदस्य सन्धि-विच्छेदः कः? (c) कासां कृते तस्याः जीवनं प्रेरणा अस्ति?
questions.answer: (a) शरीरं नश्यति (the body perishes), कीर्तिः तु न नश्यति (but fame does not perish). (b) अद्यापि = अद्य + अपि (दीर्घ-सन्धिः, अ + अ = आ). (c) भारतीयबालिकानां कृते — for Indian girls her life is a great inspiration (महती प्रेरणा).
questions.explanation: Combines comprehension with a sandhi split from within the passage.

questions.question: श्लोकं पठित्वा उत्तरत — 'उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न मनोरथैः । न हि सुप्तस्य सिंहस्य प्रविशन्ति मुखे मृगाः ॥' (a) कार्याणि केन सिध्यन्ति? (b) केन न सिध्यन्ति? (c) सुप्तस्य सिंहस्य मुखे के न प्रविशन्ति?
questions.answer: (a) कार्याणि उद्यमेन सिध्यन्ति — tasks are accomplished by effort. (b) मनोरथैः न सिध्यन्ति — they are not accomplished by mere wishes. (c) मृगाः (deer) do not enter the mouth of the sleeping lion — even the mighty must act to obtain food.
questions.explanation: Direct comprehension of the verse's three key phrases.

questions.question: श्लोकं पठित्वा उत्तरत — 'उत्साहो बलवानार्य नास्त्युत्साहात्परं बलम् । सोत्साहस्य हि लोकेषु न किञ्चिदपि दुर्लभम् ॥' (a) श्लोकानुसारं किं परमं बलम्? (b) 'नास्त्युत्साहात्' इत्यस्य सन्धि-विच्छेदः कः? (c) अयं श्लोकः कल्पनायाः जीवने कथं घटते?
questions.answer: (a) उत्साहः (enthusiasm) is the supreme strength — नास्ति उत्साहात् परं बलम्. (b) नास्त्युत्साहात् = नास्ति + उत्साहात् (यण्-सन्धिः: the इ of नास्ति becomes य् before उ). (c) The verse fits Kalpana perfectly: she had no special wealth or position, but her tireless enthusiasm for flight carried her from Karnal through engineering and NASA to space — proving that for the enthusiastic nothing is unattainable.
questions.explanation: Verse comprehension, a yan-sandhi split, and application to the heroine's life.

questions.question: अंशं पठित्वा उत्तरत — 'कल्पनायाः जीवनस्य सन्देशः अयम् — स्वप्नेभ्यः सफलतां प्रति मार्गः अस्ति एव। तं मार्गं द्रष्टुं दृष्टिः आवश्यकी, तस्मिन् मार्गे चलितुं साहसम् आवश्यकम्, गन्तव्यं प्राप्तुं च निरन्तरः परिश्रमः आवश्यकः।' (a) सन्देशानुसारं मार्गः कुतः कुत्र गच्छति? (b) मार्गे चलितुं किम् आवश्यकम्? (c) किं भवतः/भवत्याः मते अयं सन्देशः अद्यापि सत्यः? सयुक्तिकम् उत्तरत।
questions.answer: (a) The path goes from dreams to success — स्वप्नेभ्यः सफलतां प्रति. (b) To walk on the path courage is needed (साहसम् आवश्यकम्), along with vision to see it and continuous effort to reach the destination. (c) Model response: Yes — the message remains true. Opportunities have grown (education, internet, space programmes recruiting women), but they still reward only those who combine a clear dream with courage and sustained work; talent without effort still stalls, as the verse उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति warns. Kalpana's own era had fewer opportunities, yet the same three requirements carried her to space — so the principle holds across generations. (Any well-reasoned stance earns credit.)
questions.explanation: Comprehension plus an evaluated personal judgement on the message's continuing truth.

questions.question: अंशं पठित्वा उत्तरत — 'तस्याः नाम्ना नासा-संस्था एकं महासङ्गणकम् अस्थापयत्; भारतस्य एकः मौसम-उपग्रहः अपि कल्पना-१ इति नाम्ना प्रसिद्धः अस्ति। याः विज्ञानं गगनं च प्रति स्वप्नान् पश्यन्ति, ताः कल्पनायाः कथां श्रुत्वा नूतनम् उत्साहं लभन्ते।' (a) नासा-संस्था किम् अस्थापयत्? (b) कल्पना-१ इति किम्? (c) कल्पनायाः कथां श्रुत्वा काः किं लभन्ते, इति विश्लेषयत।
questions.answer: (a) NASA established a supercomputer (महासङ्गणकम्) in her name. (b) कल्पना-१ is an Indian weather satellite (मौसम-उपग्रहः) named after her. (c) Girls who dream of science and the sky (याः विज्ञानं गगनं च प्रति स्वप्नान् पश्यन्ति) gain new enthusiasm (नूतनम् उत्साहं लभन्ते) on hearing her story — because a real example from their own soil turns a distant fantasy into an attainable goal; this is how her कीर्ति actively keeps working in the world.
questions.explanation: The honours plus an analysis of how example converts dream into resolve.

questions.question: गद्यांशं पठित्वा व्याकरणप्रश्नान् उत्तरत — 'ततः सा अमेरिकादेशं गत्वा टेक्सास-विश्वविद्यालये स्नातकोत्तराम् उपाधिं प्राप्तवती, अनन्तरं च कोलोराडो-विश्वविद्यालयात् विद्यावारिधि-उपाधिं प्राप्तवती।' (a) 'गत्वा' इति पदे कः प्रत्ययः? (b) 'विश्वविद्यालयात्' इति पदे का विभक्तिः? (c) 'प्राप्तवती' इत्यस्य पुंलिङ्गरूपं किम्?
questions.answer: (a) गत्वा = गम् + क्त्वा-प्रत्ययः ('having gone'). (b) विश्वविद्यालयात् = पञ्चमी विभक्तिः, एकवचनम् ('from the university'). (c) The masculine form of प्राप्तवती is प्राप्तवान् (क्तवतु; feminine takes -वती, masculine -वान्).
questions.explanation: Grammar applied inside a running sentence: क्त्वा, ablative case, and gender conversion.

questions.question: गद्यांशं पठित्वा उत्तरत — 'शरीरं नश्यति, कीर्तिः तु न नश्यति। कल्पनायाः कीर्तिः अद्यापि विजयते।' (a) प्रथमं वाक्यम् आङ्ग्लभाषायाम् अनुवदत। (b) 'Her story inspires girls' — इति संस्कृतेन लिखत। (c) 'विजयते' इति क्रियापदं प्रयुज्य एकं नूतनं वाक्यं रचयत।
questions.answer: (a) 'The body perishes, but fame does not perish.' (b) तस्याः कथा बालिकाः प्रेरयति। (Also acceptable: तस्याः कथा बालिकानां कृते प्रेरणा अस्ति।) (c) Model sentence: सत्यम् एव विजयते। (Truth alone triumphs.) Any grammatically correct sentence with विजयते earns the mark, e.g. परिश्रमी छात्रः सर्वत्र विजयते।
questions.explanation: Two-way translation plus free composition with the verb विजयते.
